interface.name: zsingularity_motion_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets a shell tell the compositor where the launcher icon of each application is, so windows can open from it, close into it and minimize into it. Rectangles are in the surface-local coordinates of the surface that shows the icon, usually a dock. The compositor ignores rectangles of surfaces that are not mapped or not visible.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Rectangles set through it are removed.

request.name: set_icon_rect

description.summary: set the icon rectangle of an application

request.description: Sets the rectangle of the icon that represents app_id on the given surface. A width or height of zero removes it. app_id is the desktop file id or the window app_id; the compositor matches it against window app_ids ignoring case and a .desktop suffix.

request.name: clear_icon_rects

description.summary: remove every icon rectangle of a surface

request.description: Removes all rectangles set for the surface, for example when the dock hides.

request.name: launch
request.description: Announces that the user launched app_id from its icon. The next window of that application opens from the icon rectangle. The announcement expires after a few seconds.

request.name: get_card
request.description: Creates a card for the toplevel: a picture of the window that the shell moves while a finger drags it, for example when the user swipes up from the bottom edge to go home. While the card exists the window itself is not drawn; its focus and state do not change. A minimized window can have a card too, so the shell can bring in the next window of a horizontal swipe. Only one card per window exists at a time; asking again replaces the previous one.

request.name: fade_windows

description.summary: fade every window out or back in

request.description: Fades all windows, with their popups and decorations, out (faded = 1) or back in (faded = 0) over duration milliseconds, for example while the shell shows an overview above the wallpaper. Faded windows are not drawn; their focus and state do not change. The windows come back when the manager that faded them is destroyed.

interface.name: zsingularity_motion_card_v1

description.summary: a window held by the shell

interface.description: Rectangles are in output layout coordinates. The card starts where the window is, or, for a minimized window, hidden until the first set_rect.

entry.name: show
entry.summary: the window is shown, raised and focused

request.name: destroy
request.description: Drops the card at once. A card that was never released leaves the window as it was before the card existed.

request.name: set_rect
request.description: Draws the card at the rectangle with rounded corners of the given radius. Calls are applied on the next frame of the output.

request.name: release
request.description: Moves the card from where it is to the rectangle with the system spring, starting at the given velocity in layout pixels per second, then applies the action and sends done. A rectangle with zero width or height means the place of the window for show, and the application icon for minimize. Later set_rect requests are ignored.

event.name: done
event.description: Sent once the release finished and the action was applied, or when the window went away. The card has no further effect; the client destroys it.
